Library Planning Notes

The committee met on Tuesday to review the plan for the new library. Members asked about the
schedule and the budget for the parking area. The architect said that building work would start
after the winter. A quiet queue of residents waited to speak about the design of the reading

rooms and the garden. The committee met on Tuesday to review the plan for the new library.
